name: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
headline: State-of-the-art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks.
description: Mistral AI's first open source dense model released September 2023. Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Large Language Model (LLM) is an instruct fine‑tuned version of the Mistral‑7B‑v0.3. It has an extended vocabulary and supports the v3 Tokenizer, enhancing language understanding and generation. Additionally function calling is enabled.

technical_details.string_value: Prompt Processor and Token Generator are split into 4 parts each. Each corresponding Prompt Processor and Token Generator part share weights.

technical_details.key: Input sequence length for Prompt Processor

technical_details.string_value: 128 tokens + KVCache initialized with pad token
128 output tokens + KVCache for token generator
Rate of response generation after the first response token.

Time To First Token is the time it takes to generate the first response token. This is expressed as a range because it varies based on the length of the prompt. The lower bound is for a short prompt (up to 128 tokens, i.e., one iteration of the prompt processor) and the upper bound is for a prompt using the full context length (4096 tokens).
1 output token + KVCache for next iteration
Initiate conversation with prompt-processor and then token generator for subsequent iterations.
